frictions.description: The API request body format requires {"args": {"action": ...}} not {"action": ..., "params": {...}}. The SkillRunRequest model wraps all skill parameters under an 'args' key.
frictions.resolution: Inspected SkillRunRequest model in core/routes/skills.py and used correct body format

frictions.description: Task prompt suggested action names that don't match actual skill implementations: 'generate' should be 'blog_post' (content_generator), 'status' should be 'backup_status' (backup_automation), email_marketing requires 'name' parameter not specified in task prompt
frictions.resolution: Used validation error messages from the API to determine correct action names and required parameters

frictions.description: content_generator and market_intelligence skills returned 'All models unavailable' because LLM providers (OpenAI quota exhausted, Groq/Ollama fallback) couldn't generate content. Skills still executed successfully and returned 200 with structured data.
frictions.resolution: Skills handle model unavailability gracefully, returning success=true with a placeholder message. This is expected behavior per AGENTS.md (OpenAI 429, falls back to Ollama).
